summary.en: Nanjing marks the Ming court end of the voyages. The point locates the modern city centre, rather than a fifteenth-century departure quay.
summary.zh: 南京是远航与明廷相连的一端。点标出现代市中心，并非十五世纪的出发码头。

detail.en: The Yongle emperor’s court sent the first fleet in 1405. Envoys and captives later travelled back to the court.
detail.zh: 永乐皇帝的朝廷在 1405 年派出首航船队。使节与俘虏后来也被带回朝廷。

summary.en: Fuzhou helps locate the Fujian coast. The point does not identify the fleet’s departure quay or a confirmed landing.
summary.zh: 福州帮助定位福建沿岸，点位并未标出船队的出发码头或确定的登陆处。

detail.en: Navigators leaving China used compasses, observations of the sky and written sailing knowledge together.
detail.zh: 从中国出海的航海者结合罗盘、观星和文字航海知识安排航行。

summary.en: Quanzhou helps locate China’s coast. A fleet landing at this point is unconfirmed.
summary.zh: 泉州帮助定位中国沿岸，船队是否在这个点登陆仍未确定。

detail.en: The fleets depended on sailors, interpreters, medical staff and repair workers as well as commanders.
detail.zh: 船队除了统帅，也需要水手、通事、医护与修船人员。

summary.en: Melaka’s Malay rulers and merchants had their own interests. The fleets used the port to gather and store supplies. The point locates the modern city.
summary.zh: 马六甲的马来统治者和商人有自己的利益。船队在港口集合、储存物资；点位标出现代城市。

detail.en: Yin Qing was sent to Melaka in 1403, before Zheng He’s first expedition. Local rulers sought benefits from overseas ties.
detail.zh: 尹庆于 1403 年奉命前往马六甲，早于郑和第一次远航。当地统治者希望借海外联系获益。

summary.en: Later sailing charts name Temasek. Archaeological finds also show a trading settlement before 1819. These clues do not prove that Zheng He landed here.
summary.zh: 后出的航海图记有淡马锡，考古发现也说明这里在 1819 年以前已有贸易聚落。这些线索不能证明郑和登陆。

detail.en: Ceramics and coins found at Fort Canning give clues about early Singapore’s trading settlement.
detail.zh: 福康宁出土的陶瓷和钱币，留下早期新加坡贸易聚落的线索。

summary.en: Old Port is associated with modern Palembang. Ming records describe killings in this region in 1407; the exact battle site is unknown.
summary.zh: 旧港对应今天的巨港。明方记录记述 1407 年这一区域发生的杀戮，战斗的准确地点仍不清楚。

detail.en: The Ming fleet fought Chen Zuyi’s force in 1407. Chen was captured and taken to China for punishment.
detail.zh: 1407 年，明朝船队与陈祖义的势力交战。陈祖义被俘，送往中国接受惩处。

summary.en: Surabaya helps locate Java for the 1407 report of Ming troops being killed. The exact conflict site is unknown.
summary.zh: 泗水帮助定位爪哇，明方曾报告 1407 年有明军在岛上被杀。冲突的准确地点不详。

detail.en: The report comes from Ming records. It does not provide a complete count of losses on each side.
detail.zh: 报告来自明方记录，没有列出各方完整的损失人数。

summary.en: Kochi, also called Cochin and historically 柯枝, was an early expedition destination on India’s southwest coast. The point marks the modern city.
summary.zh: 科钦旧称柯枝，是早期远航在印度西南岸的目的地。点位标出现代城市。

detail.en: Early fleets reached India’s southwest-coast ports, which already belonged to wider trading networks.
detail.zh: 早期船队抵达印度西南岸港口，这些港口早已参与广阔的贸易网络。

summary.en: Calicut, now Kozhikode, was an expedition destination on India’s southwest coast. The point marks the modern city.
summary.zh: 古里，今科泽科德，是船队在印度西南岸的目的地。点位标出现代城市。

detail.en: The second expedition went to Calicut for a new king’s inauguration. Zheng He organised it but did not lead it himself.
detail.zh: 第二次远航前往古里参加新王即位典礼。郑和组织了这次航行，但未亲自率队。

summary.en: Galle is where a stone stele dated 1409 was found. It carries Chinese, Tamil and Persian texts. It does not mark a ruler’s palace or a known battle site.
summary.zh: 加勒是署年 1409 的石碑发现地，碑上有中文、泰米尔文和波斯文。这里并非已知的宫殿或战场。

detail.en: The Chinese inscription records offerings by imperial envoys to the Buddha. The other texts do not all say the same thing.
detail.zh: 中文碑文记载皇帝使节向佛陀献礼，各种文字的内容并不完全相同。

summary.en: Aden appears among the fifth expedition’s destinations. The point locates the modern port city.
summary.zh: 亚丁见于第五次远航的目的地记载。点位标出现代港口城市。

detail.en: The fifth expedition carried envoys home across the western Indian Ocean.
detail.zh: 第五次远航载着使节跨越印度洋西部，返回家乡。

summary.en: Mogadishu was an East African destination of the fifth expedition. Zheng He’s personal landing there is unconfirmed.
summary.zh: 摩加迪沙是第五次远航的东非目的地，郑和本人是否登陆仍未确定。

detail.en: This East African port had its own inhabitants, rulers and trading interests before the visiting fleets arrived.
detail.zh: 船队到访以前，这座东非港口已有居民、统治者和自己的贸易利益。

summary.en: Malindi appears in accounts of the fifth expedition. The records do not give every squadron’s or person’s full itinerary.
summary.zh: 马林迪见于第五次远航的记载。史料没有留下每支分队或每个人的完整行程。

detail.en: Visiting ships entered an existing East African trading world. Each coastal port had its own history.
detail.zh: 来访船只进入的是既有的东非贸易世界，各座沿海港口都有自己的历史。

title.zh: 苏门答剌附近区域（今司马威参照）

summary.en: Lhokseumawe helps locate the region near Samudera. The palace and capture site are unknown. Samudera was not the whole island of Sumatra.
summary.zh: 司马威帮助定位苏门答剌附近区域，宫殿和俘获地点仍不清楚。苏门答剌并非整座苏门答腊岛。

detail.en: The dispute concerned who would rule Samudera. Accounts disagree about the succession.
detail.zh: 争端涉及谁来统治苏门答剌，有关继位的记载互有矛盾。

title.zh: 孟加拉区域（今达卡参照）

summary.en: Dhaka helps locate Bengal, whose king sent the giraffe in 1414. Where the animal boarded a ship is unknown.
summary.zh: 达卡帮助定位孟加拉，其国王在 1414 年赠送长颈鹿。动物从哪里装船仍不清楚。

detail.en: Ming courtiers linked the giraffe to the qilin, a mythical creature thought to bring good fortune.
detail.zh: 明廷官员把长颈鹿与麒麟联系起来，后者是传说中带来吉祥的动物。

summary.en: Hormuz was an expedition destination on an island in the Persian Gulf. The point marks the island town, across from mainland Bandar Abbas.
summary.zh: 霍尔木兹是波斯湾的岛上远航目的地。点位标出岛上城镇，阿巴斯港则在大陆。

detail.en: Hormuz can name a town, island or strait. The fleet destination was the island port; the exact medieval harbour is unknown.
detail.zh: 霍尔木兹可以指城镇、岛屿或海峡。船队目的地是岛上港口，当时码头的准确位置仍不清楚。

summary.en: Kilwa belonged to the Swahili trading world. Chinese porcelain found there shows overseas exchange. A Ming fleet stop is unconfirmed.
summary.zh: 基尔瓦属于斯瓦希里贸易世界，当地发现的中国瓷器反映海外交换。明朝船队是否停靠仍未确定。

detail.en: Kilwa’s merchants linked goods from the African interior with markets across the Indian Ocean.
detail.zh: 基尔瓦商人把非洲腹地的物产与印度洋海外市场联系起来。

summary.en: The first expedition is usually dated 1405–1407.
summary.zh: 第一次远航通常记作 1405—1407 年。

detail.en: The Yongle emperor sent the fleet to display Ming power and expand diplomatic relations.
detail.zh: 永乐皇帝派船队远航，希望展示明朝威望，扩大外交关系。

summary.en: Ming records report 5,000 people killed in the 1407 fighting against Chen Zuyi at Old Port. No independent count confirms the figure.
summary.zh: 明方记录报告，1407 年旧港对陈祖义的战事中有 5,000 人被杀，没有独立统计可以核实。

detail.en: Old Port is associated with Palembang. The exact battle site is unknown. The report does not separate civilians from fighters or give a complete count of other losses.
detail.zh: 旧港对应今天的巨港，准确战场位置仍不清楚。报告没有分列平民与战斗人员，也没有列全其他损失。

summary.en: Wade cites Ming records reporting 170 Ming troops killed in Java in 1407. The number of local people killed is unknown.
summary.zh: 韦德（Geoff Wade）引述明方记录，报告 1407 年有 170 名明军在爪哇被杀。当地人的死亡人数不详。

detail.en: Surabaya helps locate Java for the 1407 report of Ming troops being killed. The exact conflict site is unknown.
detail.zh: 泗水帮助定位爪哇，明方曾报告 1407 年有明军在岛上被杀。冲突的准确地点不详。

summary.en: The second expedition is usually dated 1407–1409.
summary.zh: 第二次远航通常记作 1407—1409 年。

detail.en: Columbia’s account says the 1407–1409 fleet went to Calicut for a new king's inauguration. Zheng He organised it but did not lead it in person. The point locates modern Kozhikode; the ceremony site is unknown.
detail.zh: 哥伦比亚大学资料记述，1407—1409 年船队前往古里参加新王即位典礼。郑和组织了远航，但没有亲自率队。点位标出今天的科泽科德，典礼的确切地点不详。

summary.en: The third expedition is usually dated 1409–1411.
summary.zh: 第三次远航通常记作 1409—1411 年。

detail.en: Melaka served as a place to gather ships and supplies. The period also included religious offerings and fighting in Sri Lanka.
detail.zh: 马六甲供船队集合、储存物资。这一时期的锡兰往来既有宗教献礼，也有战事。

title.en: Captives taken to the Ming court

summary.en: In 1411, after fighting in Sri Lanka, Zheng He’s forces took a ruler and members of his family to the Ming court. Nanjing marks where they were taken.
summary.zh: 1411 年锡兰战事后，郑和军队把一位统治者及家人带到明廷。南京点标出他们被押送到的一端。

detail.en: The captive ruler did not govern all Sri Lanka. Columbia’s account says the captives were later released.
detail.zh: 被俘者并非全锡兰的统治者。哥伦比亚大学资料记述俘虏后来获释。

summary.en: The fourth expedition is usually dated 1413–1415.
summary.zh: 第四次远航通常记作 1413—1415 年。

detail.en: The fleet sailed beyond India to Hormuz, an island port near the Persian Gulf entrance.
detail.zh: 船队越过印度，抵达波斯湾入口附近的岛上港口霍尔木兹。

summary.en: In 1414, Bengal’s king sent the Yongle emperor a giraffe. Courtiers linked it to the qilin, a mythical creature thought to bring good fortune.
summary.zh: 1414 年，孟加拉国王赠给永乐帝一头长颈鹿。官员把它与传说中带来吉祥的麒麟联系起来。

detail.en: The giraffe reached the emperor as a gift through Bengal’s king, rather than directly from an African animal-catching trip.
detail.zh: 这头长颈鹿经过孟加拉国王赠给皇帝，并非由非洲捕兽后直接运来。

summary.en: In 1415, Zheng He captured a man claiming Samudera’s throne and took him to China. Accounts disagree about the succession dispute.
summary.zh: 1415 年，郑和俘获一位争夺苏门答剌统治权的人，把他带到中国。有关继位争端的记载互有矛盾。

detail.en: Lhokseumawe helps locate the region near Samudera. The palace and capture site are unknown. Samudera was not the whole island of Sumatra.
detail.zh: 司马威帮助定位苏门答剌附近区域，宫殿和俘获地点仍不清楚。苏门答剌并非整座苏门答腊岛。

summary.en: The fifth expedition is usually dated 1417–1419.
summary.zh: 第五次远航通常记作 1417—1419 年。

detail.en: The fleet carried envoys home. Accounts name Aden, Mogadishu and Malindi among its destinations.
detail.zh: 船队运送使节返乡，目的地记载包括亚丁、摩加迪沙和马林迪。

summary.en: The sixth expedition is usually dated 1421–1422.
summary.zh: 第六次远航通常记作 1421—1422 年。

detail.en: Envoys returned home across the Indian Ocean. Ships needed supplies and time to wait for suitable sailing conditions.
detail.zh: 使节跨越印度洋回乡。船队需要补给，也需要等待适合航行的条件。

summary.en: The seventh expedition is usually dated 1431–1433.
summary.zh: 第七次远航通常记作 1431—1433 年。

detail.en: A court order in 1430 preceded the usual sailing period. The main fleet’s destinations included Hormuz.
detail.zh: 1430 年的诏令早于通常所记的航期，主队的目的地包括霍尔木兹。

summary.en: The final state expedition ended in 1433. Maritime trade continued after the voyages stopped.
summary.zh: 最后一次国家远航于 1433 年结束，海上贸易此后仍在继续。

detail.en: Government fleets and merchant networks were different. Trade and smuggling continued under changing policies.
detail.zh: 国家船队与商人网络并不相同。政策变化之下，贸易与走私仍继续。
